interpretation_contract.solute_tail_hypothesis_falsified_if: Switching solute frozen-to-SCF has only replay-scale influence on H while switching water has material influence.
interpretation_contract.water_tail_hypothesis_falsified_if: Switching water frozen-to-SCF has only replay-scale influence on H while switching solute has material influence.
interpretation_contract.cross_incompatibility_supported_if: Both single-side contrasts are small while the nonlinear interaction is material.
interpretation_contract.hydrogen_bond_specific_hypothesis_falsif: SCF/frozen contrasts in no-HB total energies remain comparable to the full-model contrasts.
interpretation_contract.tail_descriptor_hypothesis_falsified_if: Large H changes occur without increases in the preregistered sigma-tail metrics.

hard_stop: Any confirmed MACE-EF passivity failure keeps the SCF route diagnostic-only regardless of accuracy metrics.
forbidden_repairs: record removal based on model error

claim_boundary.does_establish: Mechanism attribution within the exact frozen 20-record panel.
claim_boundary.does_not_establish: General accuracy, causal sufficiency of passivity failure, parameter transfer validity, forces, or release admission.
